mods.title: Panorama aspect (65:24)
mods.description: Replaces the 7:6 aspect with 65:24 'Panorama': menu, live-view frame, AF areas, ORF frame.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.5 build).

mods.title: Multiple Exposure: 3 and 4 frames
mods.description: Multiple Exposure accepts 3 or 4 frames. The live overlay should stay visible after every shot except the last, so you can compose the next frame on the accumulated image.
mods.camera: 3 and 4 frames worked on the camera (1.5 build); overlay after shots 2 and 3: test 1.746, awaiting camera result.

mods.title: Focus stacking with any lens
mods.description: Removes the lens check for in-camera focus stacking (the change in E1399999_Focus_Stack.BIN).
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.5 build).

mods.title: Key Line II in black and white
mods.description: Art filter Key Line II gets a grey (monochrome) toning instead of colour.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.5 build).

mods.title: Monochrome II picture profile
mods.description: i-Finish becomes 'Monochrome II': a monochrome picture profile (Monotone engine) with its own settings, moved after Monotone in the Picture Mode menu lists. The 'i-Enhance' menu and SCP cell labels become 'Monochrome II'. The i-Enhance effect-strength cell (Low/Standard/High) still appears, but has no effect on the monochrome profile. The art-filter Star Light Effect and the two Shade Effect options are hidden because they have caused camera problems. Star Light is also disabled at runtime: both image-processing snapshot builders map Add Effect value 5 to Off, so a saved selection cannot make the effect run.
mods.camera: Profile and labels worked on the camera (test 1.7.7.8); effect-strength cell still visible. Star Light/Shade hiding and the runtime Star Light disable need camera re-test.

mods.title: More arrow-key functions
mods.description: The arrow keys can be assigned 25 functions for stills and 15 for movies.
mods.camera: Not tested on the camera yet.

mods.title: Flash in handheld High Res
mods.description: Allows the flash setting in handheld High Res Shot and offers both Fill In and Manual flash with every flash type (tripod and handheld).
mods.camera: Flash worked on the camera (1.5 build); Fill In + Manual for all flash types: test 1.745.

mods.title: Art filters in High Res
mods.description: Allows art filters and e-Portrait with High Res Shot. The JPEG gets the filter's colour and tone, but High Res Shot has no art-effect pass.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.5 build), colour only.

mods.title: SCP button cell opens the main menu
mods.description: The bottom-right cell of the Super Control Panel (Button Function) opens the main menu instead, like pressing MENU on the SCP.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.679, menu and title).

mods.title: Sharpness -2 = off (linear scale)
mods.description: Sharpness becomes a straight scale of the stock +2 strength: -2 off, -1 25 %, 0 50 %, +1 75 %, +2 100 %. Stock -2 still sharpens. Flat and Log video keep their stock sharpening.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.680).

mods.title: Custom Modes C1-C4 in video
mods.description: Assign to Custom Mode also works with the dial on movie. A C slot saved there opens in video mode with its movie settings; a slot saved in a photo mode stays photo.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.681).

mods.title: Underscore in Edit Filename
mods.description: Edit Filename also offers '_' (after Z), for sRGB and Adobe RGB, so a file name can start with an underscore. Note: by the DCF standard a leading '_' marks Adobe RGB files.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.700).

mods.title: ISO-Auto down to L64
mods.description: ISO-Auto can go down to ISO 64 instead of stopping at 200. In M it always can; in P, A and S set ISO-Auto Default to 200 for no floor (Default 250 or higher still works as the floor). Upper Limit and the menus are unchanged.
mods.camera: Camera: M down to 64 (1.706); P/A/S version in 1.708/1.709.

mods.title: Movie recording limit 9 hours
mods.description: Raises the 29-minute (and 2-hour) movie recording limit to 9 hours. The camera still starts a new file at the file-size limit; card space, battery and the heat cut-out still stop recording. Same change as Caduceus' camera-tested E-P7 patch.
mods.camera: Built into test 1.709.

mods.title: More tone curves in Gradation
mods.description: Gradation (every picture mode, menu and Super Control Panel) gets 19 more curves after Low Key, from washed out to contrasty: Faded Matte, Washed Out, Soft Matte, Airy Pastel, Low Con Film, Faded Blacks, Cine Rolloff, Matte S Curve, Neutral Soft, Bright Open, Soft S Curve, Film S Curve, Crisp, Dark Moody, Punchy S Curve, Slide Film, Hard S Curve, Crushed Silver, Graphic (names in English menus). Highlight & Shadow Control applies on top. Two more options, Custom1 and Custom2, take your own curves: draw them with 'Edit curve' (empty = no change). The small Gradation cell in the SCP grid shows AUTO for all the new options; Contrast has no effect with them.
mods.camera: Art curve version worked on the camera (1.719 / 1.728); user slots 1.740; designed set: test 1.741.

mods.title: Frame art effect: plain white border
mods.description: The Frame art effect becomes a clean white border instead of the grungy film edge.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.664).

width_pct.label: Border width (% of the short side)

mods.title: White frame in Panorama
mods.description: Adds the white-border Frame masks for the Panorama aspect (stock has none there: the camera froze).
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.665).

mods.title: XPAN icon for Panorama on the SCP
mods.description: Panorama gets its own "XPAN" icons in the Super Control Panel (list, highlighted and current-value cell) instead of the 16:9 icon. Adds three icons to the camera's icon store.
mods.camera: Camera 1.666: XPAN in the SCP option lists; the main SCP cell shows a 17:9 label.

mods.title: Film looks in Custom (Caduceus recipes)
mods.description: Custom becomes a film-look mode: hue, saturation and lightness per colour from Caduceus's film recipes (31 looks). Pick six here; on the camera choose between them in Picture Mode > Custom > first item, whose list shows the look names. Other picture modes and menus are unchanged. Custom's own base-mode look (Vivid, Natural...) is replaced; tone, grain and WB shift of the recipes are not applied yet. With 'Load looks from SD card', Custom's list shows Look 1-6 and, at the first half-press after switching on, the camera reads EM1MOD/LOOKS.BIN from the card in slot 1 (button 'Write card file' below); without the file it uses the six looks picked here. Looks: Caduceus by cakelesscoder (Apache-2.0).
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.691).

sd.label: Load looks from SD card (not camera-tested)

mods.title: Owner name and phone in the main menu
mods.description: The 'Shooting Menu 1' title at the top of the main menu shows your text instead, e.g. your name and phone number, so a lost or stolen camera can be traced back to you. Up to 36 characters; '@' (email) does not display. English menus only.
mods.camera: Worked on the camera (1.6 build 1.701; an email with @ did not display).
